description:
Surah An-Naas Beautiful Recitation | Protection from Evil, Black Magic & Shaitan | Tilawat for Peace

Listen to the beautiful and heart-touching recitation of Surah An-Naas from the Holy Quran. This powerful surah is known for protection from evil whispers, black magic, evil eye, and Shaytan.
Surah An-Naas is one of the most powerful supplications for spiritual protection and peace of mind. Reciting it daily brings comfort, removes negative energy, and strengthens faith.


✨ Benefits of Surah An-Naas: • Protection from black magic
• Protection from evil eye
• Relief from anxiety and fear
• Spiritual peace and blessings
• Protection from Shaytan’s whispers
Listen daily for spiritual healing and protection.
📿 Surah: An-Naas
📖 Para: 30
🕋 From: The Holy Quran
